title: Canonicalize Bureau scheduler deployment sources
goal: Give the installed bureau_cycle stages and closure planner one versioned source of truth, immutable release identity and drift check while preserving compatibility with current unit names.

acceptance.assertion: Each installed cycle module, libexec shim and timer names one canonical repository path and immutable release identity.
Discovery, curator, operator, verifier and closure planner units are versioned or explicitly delegated to another canonical deployment repository.
A read-only check compares live unit and executable identities with the canonical release and reports mismatch without self-healing.
Any rename of bureau-halfhour-operator preserves a documented compatibility alias and rollback until consumers are migrated.

lease_scope_migration.rationale: Scheduler canonicalization spans versioned automation, immutable runtime identity and launcher/drift code.
does_not_establish: safe mutation of terminal historical tasks

metadata.outcome: Bureau PR #1491 versioned all five scheduler stages, timers and compatibility shims. The current immutable Bureau release and all 15 live files now agree; systemd verification, timer reload and an independent drift audit completed successfully.

activation.timer_state: all five active, enabled and waiting

validated_acceptance.source-owner: PASS — repository sources, immutable release and all installed stage files share one release identity.
validated_acceptance.unit-coverage: PASS — discovery, curator, operator, verifier and closure services/timers plus five compatibility shims are versioned and installed.
validated_acceptance.drift-check: PASS — independent bureau cycle-deployment returned status ok, no findings, read_only true and self_heal false.
validated_acceptance.compatibility: PASS — bureau-halfhour-operator keeps its stable unit and shim names; all previous live bytes are preserved in 15 rollback backups.

validation: PR #1491 exact-head validate (3.10), validate (3.12), CodeQL, analyses and Registry preflight passed.
Closeout local make validate passed 1103 tests and 18 subtests; Registry and Systemkatalog checks passed.
Activation systemd-analyze --user verify returned 0 for all ten unit files.
All five previously active timers returned active/enabled/waiting after daemon-reload and controlled restart.
No service oneshot was manually started during activation.
Independent postflight returned cycle-deployment status ok with zero findings.
